integrity: The proof uses an exact mixture representation by centered discrete uniforms and the strict concavity of their mean-absolute-deviation versus variance curve. Exact-rational computation only replays the formulas and finite stress tests.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes a symmetric unimodal probability mass function on the integer lattice.
The lower endpoint is an unattained infimum because no support-radius bound is imposed.
The originality search was targeted and may miss an equivalent formulation in older discrete-unimodality literature.
title: Sharp lattice mean-absolute-deviation envelope for symmetric unimodal laws
